args.summary: Following deployment of v2.3.1, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Per the platform runbook, the service was rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback succeeded in all regions; service is now healthy with error rate ~0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure to be investigated before redeployment.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after health check failures

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in production, with v2.3.0 being the most recent healthy release. Current status confirmed v2.3.1 failing in all 3 regions with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery**: Service is now healthy with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the recovery — the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1's root cause should be investigated before it's redeployed; a redeploy of that unhealthy version would require change-manager approval per policy.
